All 16 repositories are indexed and reachable at the pinned commits (I verified react @ `3a717e42…`, zustand @ `beca84e6…`, react-redux @ `ad5d1e08…`, and each other repo by passing the pinned hash to the tools; `roll_call` reports a newer head for react/redux/table/zustand, but the pinned snapshots are indexed and I queried those explicitly).

The contract: **the value a subscribable source hands back when rendered with no live subscription (the server snapshot) must be identical to the value the first hydrating client render computes.** Confirmed at source: `zustand/src/react.ts:30-34` and `src/traditional.ts:36-42` hand back `api.getInitialState()` on the server — the *default* state, not the populated one; `react-server/ReactFizzHooks.js` falls back to `getSnapshot` when no server getter is given, and `react-reconciler/ReactFiberHooks.js` is the file that throws the hard "requires a server snapshot" error and owns the hydration-agreement invariant; `preact-query/src/utils.ts:16-19` reimplements `useSyncExternalStore` with **no** server-snapshot parameter at all.
